author: MelodyHSong (Cassiopeia Studios)
description: Production-grade modular scaffolding for Windows desktop utilities and Tkinter workstations.

tier_1_core.name: Core Essentials
tier_1_core.description: Mandatory foundational files required for any desktop tool to function.

tier_2_windows.name: Windows Shell Integration
tier_2_windows.description: Explorer right-click context menu file associations, Start Menu & Desktop shortcuts, and HKCU registry configuration.

tier_3_packaging.name: Standalone Binary & Release Packaging
tier_3_packaging.description: PyInstaller specification, build scripts, automated portable zip packaging with SHA-256 checksums, and release note drafts.

tier_4_github.name: GitHub Ecosystem & CI/CD
tier_4_github.description: GitHub Actions automated build/release workflows, issue templates, funding config, contribution guidelines, changelog, and packaging metadata.

minimal.name: Minimal / Embedded Utility
minimal.description: Quick, self-contained desktop tool meant to live inside a code snippets folder or be run directly via Python.

shell_integrated.name: Shell-Integrated Desktop App
shell_integrated.description: Desktop utility that associates with file extensions in Windows Explorer and creates Desktop/Start Menu shortcuts without requiring UAC elevation.

portable_dist.name: Standalone Portable Distribution
portable_dist.description: Desktop utility ready for standalone binary compilation with PyInstaller and packaging into portable ZIP releases with SHA-256 checksums.

full_repository.name: Full Standalone GitHub Repository
full_repository.description: Complete production-ready repository like StellarNotes, complete with CI/CD workflows, issue templates, funding, changelog, and PyPI packaging metadata.

components.description: Core Tkinter application entry point with dark theme, High-DPI scaling, and async background workers.
Smart Windows launcher script prioritizing standalone binary -> pythonw -> python.
Python package dependencies (Pillow for icons, PyInstaller for compilation).
Multi-resolution Windows icon asset (256x256, 48x48, 32x32, 16x16).
Pillow script to programmatically render high-resolution application icons.
Default configuration and user preferences for persistent storage.
Git exclusion rules for PyInstaller builds, bytecode caches, virtualenvs, and user state.
MIT License terms.
Comprehensive project documentation, quick-start guide, and keyboard shortcuts.
Windows Registry manager for Explorer right-click context menus, Desktop & Start Menu shortcuts.
